title: 'Kicking Off' a New Year
credits: Anna Matteo wrote this story for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: And now, Words and Their Stories, from VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们来听《词汇与故事》，这是来自美国之音英语学习节目。

sentences.en: One of the most popular sports in the United States is American football.
sentences.zh: 在美国最受欢迎的运动之一是美国橄榄球。

sentences.en: In the U.S., “football” is a sport that involves a lot of contact.
sentences.zh: 在美国，"橄榄球"是一项涉及大量身体接触的运动。

sentences.en: What people around the world call “football,” Americans call soccer.
sentences.zh: 全世界所称的"足球"，美国人称之为"soccer"。

sentences.en: For today’s show, we talk about some idioms and expressions that come from American football.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们来聊一些源自美国橄榄球的成语和表达。

sentences.en: The American sport mainly involves carrying or throwing the ball.
sentences.zh: 这项美国运动主要涉及带球或传球。

sentences.en: But there are times when a player must use their feet to kick the ball.
sentences.zh: 但有时球员必须用脚踢球。

sentences.en: The kicker can kick field goals to get points.
sentences.zh: 踢球者可以踢任意球得分。

sentences.en: In addition to that, the game starts with a kickoff and, after scoring points, a team will kick off to the other side, beginning their turn on offense.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，比赛以开球开始，得分后，球队会开球给对方，从而开始他们的进攻。

sentences.en: The term kickoff is commonly used to describe the start of an event or project.
sentences.zh: "开球"这个词通常用来描述活动或项目的开始。

sentences.en: For example, we could say experts from all over the world attended the kickoff of the new language museum.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们可以说来自世界各地的专家参加了新语言博物馆的开馆仪式。

sentences.en: You can use it as a phrasal verb, as well.
sentences.zh: 你也可以把它当作一个动词短语来用。

sentences.en: For example, people often like to “kick off” the new year with a resolution, or promise to yourself, to reach a goal or to do something.
sentences.zh: 例如，人们常常喜欢用"新年决心"来开启新的一年，也就是给自己一个目标或承诺去完成某件事。

sentences.en: Football also has the term “punt.”
sentences.zh: 橄榄球还有一个词叫"踢远球"。

sentences.en: Punting is another sort of kick a team uses when they cannot score.
sentences.zh: 踢远球是球队在无法得分时使用的另一种踢球方式。

sentences.en: The punter kicks a ball with the top of his foot.
sentences.zh: 踢远球的人用脚背踢球。

sentences.en: “Punt,” like “kick,” can be both a noun and a verb.
sentences.zh: "踢远球"和"踢球"一样，既可以是名词也可以是动词。

sentences.en: When you punt the ball, you put it in play for the other team.
sentences.zh: 当你踢远球时，你就把球交给了对方球队。

sentences.en: The same can be said for punting in life.
sentences.zh: 对于人生中的踢远球，情况也是如此。

sentences.en: When we punt something, we give our task, job, or responsibility to someone else.
sentences.zh: 当我们踢远球某件事时，我们就把任务、工作或责任交给了别人。

sentences.en: For example, if I’m not good at a certain task or I just don’t want to do it, I can punt it to someone else.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果我不擅长某项任务，或者我根本不想做，我就可以把它推给别人。

sentences.en: It can also mean to delay a decision.
sentences.zh: 它也可以意味着推迟做决定。

sentences.en: If I’m not sure about taking a trip, for example, I can punt the decision until later.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果我对是否出行还拿不准，我就可以把决定推迟到以后。

sentences.en: Another way to say this in American English is to table it.
sentences.zh: 在美式英语中，表达这个意思的另一种说法是把它搁置。

sentences.en: If you are not ready to think about something, it can or must wait until later.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没准备好去想某件事，它就可以或者必须等到以后再考虑。

sentences.en: In football, the kicker not only starts the game with a kickoff but also kicks field goals.
sentences.zh: 在橄榄球比赛中，踢球手不仅开球时负责开球，还负责踢进球得分。

sentences.en: To do this, the kicker must kick the football between the goalposts at either end of the football field.
sentences.zh: 要做到这一点，踢球手必须把球踢过橄榄球场两端球门柱之间的区域。

sentences.en: If he succeeds, his team gets three points.
sentences.zh: 如果他成功，他的球队就能得到三分。

sentences.en: Kicking a field goal can be difficult if the kicker is far from the goalposts or if the weather in an outdoor stadium is windy, rainy or snowy.
sentences.zh: 如果踢球手离球门柱较远，或者室外球场的天气有风、下雨或下雪，踢进球得分就会很困难。

sentences.en: But imagine if the goalposts were moving?
sentences.zh: 但如果球门柱会移动呢？

sentences.en: That would make kicking the ball between them much more difficult.
sentences.zh: 那就会让把球踢过两柱之间变得困难得多。

sentences.en: We can face this problem in everyday life.
sentences.zh: 在日常生活中，我们也会遇到这样的问题。

sentences.en: Imagine if you are given a task at work with specific goals to reach.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，如果在工作时被交给一项有明确目标要完成的任务。

sentences.en: For example, if you are a social media manager you could be asked to increase followers by 10,000 by the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你是一名社交媒体经理，可能会被要求在月底之前增加1万粉丝。

sentences.en: But when the end of the month comes, your boss tells you that now you need to add 20,000 followers, not 10,000.
sentences.zh: 可是到了月底，老板却告诉你，现在需要增加2万粉丝，而不是1万。

sentences.en: In this case, your boss has moved the goalpost.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，你的老板就是移动了球门柱。

sentences.en: Sometime a person moves the goalposts on purpose.
sentences.zh: 有时，一个人会故意移动球门柱。

sentences.en: They have a reason for doing so.
sentences.zh: 他这么做是有原因的。

sentences.en: If the goalposts keep moving, it is difficult or even impossible to reach the goal.
sentences.zh: 如果球门柱不断移动，那就很难甚至根本无法达成目标。

sentences.en: So, if you say that someone has “moved the goalposts,” you are accusing them of changing the rules or end goals to make it difficult for you to succeed.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果说某人“移动了球门柱”，你就是在指责他们改变了规则或最终目标，好让你难以成功。

sentences.en: We can also say to move the target to mean the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我们也可以说“移动目标”来表示同样的意思。

sentences.en: A moving target is a changing goal or result.
sentences.zh: 移动的目标意味着一个不断变化的目标或结果。

sentences.en: A desired goal, end, or objective that changes all the time is difficult or perhaps even impossible to reach.
sentences.zh: 一个时时刻刻都在改变的理想目标、终点或目的，往往难以实现，甚至根本不可能实现。

sentences.en: Both expressions – to move the goalposts and to move the target – can be used in the same way and in similar situations.
sentences.zh: “移动球门”和“移动目标”这两种说法可以同样地使用，也适用于类似的情境。

sentences.en: However, moving the goalposts is a classic football expression.
sentences.zh: 不过，“移动球门”是足球运动中的经典用语。

sentences.en: While moving the target can refer to several sports.
sentences.zh: 而“移动目标”则可以指代多种体育运动。

sentences.en: And that’s Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 以上就是“Words and Their Stories”。

sentences.en: Until next time, I’m Anna Matteo.
sentences.zh: 下次见，我是安娜·马泰奥。

one of the best examples of something
to have a connection to or be related to something
